title: Loss-aware OT-DRO linear regression (Sec. 6.2, J=10): learn the transport cost L per instance

split.decision: generator bench/generator.py = paper Sec. 6.2 / App. E.2 DGP with the 10 fixed Table-3 models, J=10, n_b=20. val = 20 public instances (models 0-9 x archived data seeds 1000m+{0,3}); test = 30 instances (models 0-9 x 3 hidden random seeds, listed only in NOTES/judge); train = 50 public labelled instances (seeds 1000m+100+d, d<5) that the baseline does not use. predict.sh learns L per instance (paper protocol); train.sh is a no-op.

baseline.paper_ref: paper Fig. 5 right / Fig. 7 at J=10: mean l* ~28.16 (read off the figure, 100 instances); archived in-sample reproduction on the 100 instances 1000m+d: 29.5823 (se 0.73); noise floor 22.451

allowed_changes: Methods for learning L/eps, bilevel optimization, auxiliary optimization losses, numerical differentiation, conic/other solvers and tuning may change.
Any submitted w must still solve the same fixed DRO objective for its submitted ambiguity set; Adam/initial radius learning and stopping choices are baseline methods.
When retaining the supplied bilevel optimization pipeline, changing only gamma=0.1, learning_rate=1e-4, lambda=10, eta=100, rel_impr_obj=1e-6 or n_iter_max=1e6 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Learn an admissible type-1 Wasserstein ambiguity geometry and radius for the fixed scalar absolute-loss DRO regression problem, minimizing out-of-sample absolute error.
The decision model y_hat=w*x without intercept, absolute residual loss and DRO objective mean|y-w*x|+eps*||L^-1[-w,1]|| are fixed.

Mahalanobis ground cost ||L^T(xi1-xi2)||, positive lower-triangular L/radius, ten observations/twenty supplied resamples, optimality/exceedance/coverage guards and exact expected-absolute-error metric remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace linear regression by a nonlinear model, absolute loss by squared error, type-1 cost by another ambiguity class, or submit an arbitrary low-error decision that is not DRO-optimal.
No Table3 truth/model-ID lookup, extra observations/resamples, hidden true distribution access or altered metric/guards.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
